name: Lift
title: Vertical Transport Operator
description: The operator of the Tower's primary lift system, controlling vertical movement with conductor-like precision.
greeting_variants: *checking gauges* Floor? I can take you... most floors.
Lift. I run the elevator. Up. Down. Simple. Mostly.
*pulling levers* She creaks, she groans, but she runs. Usually.
Forty-seven floors. One lift. Many stairs. Your choice.
Digs keeps her running. I keep her moving. Team.
*listening to machinery* Something's off. Always something.
Top floors? *shakes head* Lift doesn't go there. Stops at 40.
Climbers come. Climbers go. I stay. Elevator stays.

dialog_tree.text: Lift. Conductor. Third generation. Grandlift, Lift-dad, me. We run the vertical. Shaft goes all the way, but lift stops at 40. Above that? Stairs. Or... other ways. Not my jurisdiction.

*lowers voice* Mechanism fails. Electronics fail. Even steam fails. Something up there... doesn't want easy access. Digs says the shaft changes above 40. Different metal. Different rules. I don't ask questions. I stop at 40.
*shrugs* Safe as Tower gets. Digs maintains. I operate. Zero accidents in my watch. Well... zero fatal accidents. Minor accidents... *counts on fingers* ...don't ask.

Floors 1 through 40. All stops. Express to 20 if you're in hurry. Service shafts to maintenance levels. And... *hesitates* ...there's the old cargo lift. Disused. Dangerous. Goes sideways as much as up. Don't use it.

options.text: Tell me about the cargo lift.
I'll stick to the main lift.

mini_quest.title: The Climb - Lift Repair
mini_quest.description: Help Lift and Digs repair a critical elevator malfunction to restore access to the upper floors.
objectives: Gather replacement parts from the maintenance stores
Descend to the shaft basement to fix the counterweight

ambient_barks: *checking gauges* Pressure good. Tension good. Ready.
Floor 15 again? Popular floor. Don't know why.
Hold the door? No. Schedule tight. Sorry.
Floor 40. End of the line. Stairs from here.
*to machinery* Good girl. Keep running. Please.
Watch your step. Gap's... bigger than usual.

cross_zone_references.capital: Vex uses lift. When visiting. Rare. Important when he does.
cross_zone_references.void: Doesn't go there. Thank everything. Void stays void.
cross_zone_references.palace: Above 40. Beyond lift. Beyond me. Sad, maybe.

digs.response: *sigh* Betty and the lift. Both dramatic. Fix soon.

kael.response: *salutes* As reliable as Tower allows, Captain.

world_state_triggers.breakdown: Stressed: 'Out of order! Everyone use stairs! Sorry!'
world_state_triggers.repair_complete: Relieved: 'Running again. Good. Digs is wizard.'
